description: Top-level lane assignments per repo failure class. Three lanes: SAFE-AUTO, GATED-PR, HUMAN-ONLY. NEVER bypass for any reason.

safe-auto.description: May auto-execute. May auto-merge ONLY when SITA_SAFE_AUTOMERGE=1 AND all 4 validation stages pass AND blast radius within cap.

gated-pr.description: May auto-execute. NEVER auto-merge. Always raises a draft PR for human review.

human-only.description: May analyze and propose, NEVER executes. Surfaces in dashboard for human action.

patchApplicationGate.description: Hard floor for ANY patch application — enforced by policy-engine.decideRepair regardless of lane, feature flag, or confidence. Cannot be bypassed.
